BLO App is a mobile application created for Booth Level Officers of ECI and its purpose is to facilitate the elections officials as well as citizens. This mobile application is exclusively meant for the Election Commission of India enumerators like BLO, who can use it for multiple purposes like form filling and verification features. BLOs will ensure the facilities available at polling stations and nearby it for voters.\nThrough this mobile application, the Election officials can view the density of electors’ part wise.

Yes. In the BLO App, BLO has the provision for filling the forms on behalf of the new elector. BLO will enter details as per the available data of citizens, and BLO can process as per the requirement.
Form 6: New Voter Registration for Ordinary Resident
Form 6A: New Voter Registration for Overseas Voter
Form 6B: Aadhar Collection for Existing Elector/Voter
Form 7: Objection/ Deletion in Electoral Roll
Form 8:Form for Shifting/Correction/Replacement of EPIC/Marking PwD.

The device compatibility report in the App is to ensure that the device has all the necessary functionality which will be used on the ground level. For e.g. Camera, Android Version i.e. jellybean, Available Memory, Internet, Available Storage and etc. This is required because the updated version will be more user-friendly and easy to use. Internet will also work properly in the latest device that is why the compatibility check is must before using the app.

You should have an android or iOS based smartphone or tablet with a SIM and working mobile connection. The smartphone should have a minimum 5-megapixel camera, 2 GB of free space, and a good battery. Always an external battery power bank is a preferable feature.

BLO verifies the forms requests which are applied through the Voter Helpline App and Voter Service Portal for the designated (6, 6 A, 6 B, 7, 8). Details will be pre-filled in the forms.
Form 6: New Voter Registration for Ordinary Resident
Form 6A: New Voter Registration for Overseas Voter
Form 6B: Aadhar Collection for Existing Elector/Voter
Form 7: Objection/ Deletion in Electoral Roll
Form 8: Form for Shifting/Correction/Replacement of EPIC/Marking PwD
This feature allows the BLO to ensure the necessary facility at/nearby the Polling stations. He has to verify listed facilities and rating for their quality in the form of star rating.

There are 2 main features of BLO App. The features are the following:
1.Integrated BLONet Features:- BLO net features incorporated for making a checklist for BLO and takes action for New Registration for Ordinary Resident, New Registration for Overseas Voter, Deletion/ Objection of Entries, Correction of Particulars in Electoral Roll and Transposition Entry in the same assembly but a different part.
Checklist Requests- 6, 6A, 7, 8
New form submissions - 6, 6A, 7, 8
2. Facility Management:- To verify the available facilities like- Electricity, drinking water, telephone connectivity etc. at the polling station. In the other facility- BLO has to update Nearest Bus stand/ Police station/ Fire station/ Fuel pump data/Hospitals.
